'''Storm Commando armor''' was a special type of [[Armor/Legends|body armor]] worn by [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]], the [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. The design was created by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nashiak Llalik]] and based on the [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|light armor]] worn by [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout troopers]],<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> albeit colored matte black, hence their nickname of "shadow scouts."

==Characteristics==
Like scout trooper armor, Storm Commando armor was blast reinforced to provide protection against physical and energy attacks without being restrictive to wear. It also shared the climate-controlled sealed body glove and breath mask which allowed the wearer to operate in toxic and otherwise hostile environments.<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref><ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> Its most notable feature however was its special polymer coating known as [[Reflec/Legends|reflec]] which bent both light and sensor energy away from it. This made the wearer practically invisible to most sensor scans, although a determined attempt could detect them.<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|stormcommandos|Storm commandos}}</ref> The armor also had a layer of sound baffling built into it, enabling the Storm Commando to move more quietly.<ref name="GG9" /> The radius of the sound dampener was able to reach up to a meter.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

The armor's helmet contained standard features like a tongue-activated [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and [[Multi-Frequency Targeting and Acquisition System/Legends|Multi-Frequency Targeting and Acquisition System]]. In addition the helment's viewplate doubled as a [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinocular]] with a range of one kilometer and ultraviolet night vision capability.<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="FOP" /><ref name="ROE" />

The armor included a utility belt to carry the equipment necessary for the Storm Commando's mission. Standard gear included a high-tension wire, grappling hooks, spare blaster power packs, ion flares, food rations and water packs, a spare comlink, and two [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], with additional pouches for carrying other supplies.<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="FOP" /><ref name="ROE" />

Since Storm Commandos preferred to operate in darkness, their armor was normally painted black with no distinguishing markings such as unit insignias.<ref name="GG9" />
